race.comment: YORKSHIRE GIRL (3) has raced below best last couple, the latest managing only 5th (24.90) last time in a Grade 5 at Sale. Goes very well at course and distance boasting four wins. Tough to beat if on-song. PLAYBACK (4) has shown good improvement at his last two starts, finishing in the money last time when 2nd at this track over 425m. Must be included in calculations. DR. GIANNA (7) turned in a plain run last time when fifth at this track over 425m behind That's My Boy (24.67) in a Grade 5. The form from her last run stacks up well. Great chance to atone. ESSENDON GIRL (2) can fill a top-three spot. Something for the Multiples: MAUDIE ROSE (8)
